messages:
kevin: quick summary — ran exhaustive RoPE variant sweep (linear/ntk/yarn) across mixtral-8k / qwen-7b / llama-13b; reproducible perf cliff when KV is enabled and kernel stride checks fail. pasting minimal repro and notes for triage.
sophie: please paste repro + short logs so we can triage.
kevin: repro (canary pool):
```
./longctx_sweep --model mixtral-8k --rope ntk --batch 4 --seq 10976 --kv=true --profile=gpu
```
kevin: short log excerpt (trimmed):
```
[info] 2005000001 kernel_router: selected=generic_gemm reason=stride_mismatch computed_stride=58 expected=64
[warn] 2005000001 kv_cache: evicting_pages=3 contiguous_region_exhausted latency_spike_ms=305
[perf] 2005000001 gpu: launches=22 tiny_kernels instead_of=5 fused_kernels
```
anika: kernel-router falls back because computed_stride (pre-pack) != kernel.expected_stride (packed). our current check doesn't account for kv_pack/quantization padding so some head_kv combos flip the parity.
jin: profiler shows L2 thrash and many small launches; batching couldn't coalesce because prefix variance in the batch > 512 tokens. that produced many distinct kernel shapes.
lina: allocator traces (nvprof) show repeated small device frees during eviction windows, causing fragmentation; free churn increases chance of contiguous_region_exhausted.
kevin: quick mitigations we tested: pad short prefixes up to 64/128 boundary before packing. this reduced distinct kernel shapes by ~60% and removed the cliff, at cost of ~7-10% throughput loss from extra padding work.
sophie: ops note: will schedule canary window and avoid landing any kernel-router changes in prod until we have a pinned mitigation.
anika: suggested short-term fixes:
- model-table override: prefer kernel_v2_ntk_padded for mixtral-8k at seq > 8k; prefer kernel_v1_linear for qwen-7b > 9k
- batching heuristic: if prefix_variance > 512, prefer padded packing to reduce tiny kernels
- emit effective_head_stride (post-pack) in kernel-select logs for future triage
- throttle concurrent KV evictions to avoid simultaneous device frees
jin: longer-term ideas:
- compute padded_stride = f(head_dim, kv_pack, quant_pad) in router and match kernels to padded_stride rather than raw_stride
- slow-path fallback: try 1 alternative optimized kernel variant before falling back to generic_gemm
- packing strategy chooser: try tight pack + padded pack and pick the one yielding fewer distinct kernel shapes (cheap heuristic)
kevin: actionable items (owners):
- kevin: full deterministic sweep matrix across linear/ntk/yarn for mixtral-8k, qwen-7b, llama-13b; collect throughput / p99 / ppl by seq_len. due: EOD tomorrow
- anika: nvprof allocator timeline and fragmentation analysis. due: EOD tomorrow
- jin: prototype padded packer and run A/B on canary. due: tomorrow AM
- sophie: orchestrate canary windows + temporary model-table overrides if clear winners appear
- lina: confirm allocator free churn vs eviction correlation and test throttle impact
sophie: I'll post a short summary to #eng-runtime after the sweep and coordinate with support to isolate dedicated test tenants from canary pools. ping me if you need escalation.
